subject: Leaf scavenger hunt, Tyke Hikes and a Frozen movie night
preheader: Plus: Memorial Park's new Camp Logan Playground is under construction.
intro: Halloween is behind us, and the next two weeks are quiet in the best way. Saturday afternoon, the Arboretum has a free fall-leaf scavenger hunt on the trails, and Tyke Hikes start up again Monday for your 18-months-to-4 crowd.

Two heads-ups: clocks went back this weekend, so expect early wake-ups for a few days, and Hatchlings baby classes at the Arboretum are sold out this fall. Looking ahead, put Friday, Dec 4 on the calendar for a free Frozen movie night in Memorial Park.
